name: How do I know if my deck's support posts are failing?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my deck's support posts are failing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Failing deck support posts often show signs of rot, especially at ground level or where they meet concrete. Look for visible cracks, soft spots when probed, or a general leaning or instability of the posts. Significant settling of the deck in one area can also indicate a failing post. Regular inspection for moisture damage and insect activity is important.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for rot, cracks, soft spots, leaning, or instability in the posts. Deck settling can also be a sign of failing supports.
